Definition: Eden, the region of Adam's home
BiblicalUsage: Eden is the garden God planted in the east, where He put the man He had formed to dress it and keep it, and from which Adam and Eve were driven out after they ate of the forbidden tree. The garden held the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and cherubim guarded the way back once the man and woman were sent out. A Levite named Eden also served in Hezekiah's day, but the garden is the Eden the Bible means most often.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eden shows what we lost and what God promises to restore, because the garden was good and the exile from it was real. I hold that the way back runs through the cross, and the end of the story is a garden again.
